meta.themes: Agent Platforms, Coding Agents, AI Infrastructure, AI Policy

news.title: Apple rebuilt Siri as a personal AI assistant
news.summary: Apple introduced Siri AI at WWDC26, promising conversational answers, personal context, onscreen awareness, systemwide app actions, and a privacy architecture built around on-device models and Private Cloud Compute.

news.title: OpenAI moved to acquire Ona for persistent Codex workspaces
news.summary: OpenAI said it will acquire Ona to add secure, customer-controlled cloud execution and orchestration to Codex so long-running software and knowledge-work agents can operate beyond a single local session.

news.title: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5
news.summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Fable 5 for broad use and Mythos 5 for restricted high-risk research and cyber workflows, then updated the page as access was disrupted by a U.S. government directive.

news.title: Google released Gemini 3.5 Live Translate
news.summary: Google launched Gemini 3.5 Live Translate for near real-time speech-to-speech translation across more than 70 languages, with developer preview access through the Gemini Live API and enterprise preview in Google Meet.

news.title: Google introduced DiffusionGemma for faster local text generation
news.summary: Google released DiffusionGemma, an experimental Apache 2.0 model that uses text diffusion to generate blocks of text in parallel for speed-critical local workflows such as inline editing and rapid iteration.

news.title: AWS added Gemma 4 models to Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: AWS made Google DeepMind's Gemma 4 family available on Bedrock, adding open-weight reasoning, multimodal, function-calling, and software-engineering models across several U.S. and European regions.

news.title: GitHub Copilot CLI gained a unified /settings command
news.summary: GitHub added a schema-driven /settings surface to Copilot CLI, giving developers a searchable UI and scriptable command path for changing user settings without hand-editing config files.

news.title: Cursor made Bugbot faster, cheaper, and available before push
news.summary: Cursor said Bugbot is now more than 3x faster, 22% cheaper, and finds 10% more bugs per review, while a new /review flow lets teams run Bugbot and Security Review before pushing code.

news.title: NVIDIA Blackwell led the first agentic AI infrastructure benchmark
news.summary: NVIDIA said Blackwell Ultra NVL72 topped Artificial Analysis' first AgentPerf benchmark, running up to 20x more agents per megawatt than Hopper on DeepSeek V4 Pro agentic workloads.

news.title: Anthropic and TCS partnered on Claude for regulated industries
news.summary: Anthropic and Tata Consultancy Services announced a partnership to deploy Claude to 50,000 TCS employees and build regulated-industry offerings for financial services, healthcare, public sector, aviation, and telecom clients.

news.title: Anthropic urged Congress to require independent AI safety tests
news.summary: Reuters reported that Anthropic asked U.S. lawmakers not to preempt state AI rules unless Congress passes rigorous federal standards, including independent safety tests for the most capable models.

news.title: OpenAI filed for a U.S. IPO after Anthropic
news.summary: Reuters reported that OpenAI confidentially filed for a U.S. IPO after Anthropic, setting up a major public-market test for frontier AI labs, investor appetite, and the capital demands of model development.
